description: This file defines the EmailSubscriberDao class which manages database operations related to email subscribers within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting email subscriber data, and interacts with entities such as EmailNotification and EmailSubscriber.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing email subscriber database interactions in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmailSubscribersByEmailSubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmailSubscriber entities associated with a specific email subscription ID, filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberByEmailSubscriptionIdPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object to enable paginated retrieval of email subscribers filtered by subscription ID and search parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberListCountByEmailSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the count of email subscribers for a given subscription ID, matching specified filters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionById
methods.description: Fetches an EmailNotification entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Persists an EmailSubscriber entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmailSubscriber entity based on subscriber ID and subscription ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmailSubscriberIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing email subscriber IDs from a provided list.

methods.name: deleteEmailSubscribersByIds
methods.description: Deletes multiple email subscribers identified by their IDs and returns the count of deleted records.
